reader.notes: The compile-time agreement check compares FileEntryIdentity.Segments, whose ALT segment carries each alternate key's name, offset, width, description and DUPLICATES, sorted, so count, location, description and DUPLICATES are all compared; the same fingerprint is registered for the run-time EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH check between separately compiled elements (not probed: the probe runner takes one source). The COBOL6847 message cites §1985:IX.2.3.4 GR1 and not IX.2.5.4 GR5; cosmetic only.
